name: The Role Of The Man
overview: Scripture reveals that the role of the man is established from creation, where God recognized that it was not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). A man is called to walk in righteousness, avoiding ungodly counsel and sinful paths (Psalms 1:1), and to lead by example in training his children in the way they should go (Proverbs 22:6). While Galatians 3:28 affirms unity in Christ beyond distinctions of gender, Ephesians 5 emphasizes the distinct responsibilities of the husband as the head of the wife, called to love sacrificially as Christ loved the church (Ephesians 5:23, 25).
